dict.string: Buntini listens only while you hold the dictation key or press the mic, during a voice conversation you start, while a call you record runs, and for “Hey Buntini” if you turn it on. Your voice is turned into words on this Mac.
Buntini records the Mac's sound only while you record a call, so your notes include everyone on it. The audio stays on this Mac and is deleted once the notes are written.
Buntini turns your voice into words on this Mac with Apple's speech recognition.
Buntini connects to an AI server on your network only if you add one.
Buntini uses only the apps you allow in Settings → Apps: it reads them on this Mac, and adds or drafts things only after you approve each one.
Buntini shows your events when you ask and in your morning brief, only after you allow Calendar in Settings → Apps.

Buntini lists your open reminders when you ask and in your morning brief, only after you allow Reminders in Settings → Apps.

Buntini looks up the people you name, such as who to address a draft to, only after you allow Contacts in Settings → Apps.
Buntini finds and shows the photos you ask for, only after you allow Photos in Settings → Apps. It never changes your library.
